༄༅/ /gnas lnga rig pa'i dbang phyug slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo'i zhabs kyi gsung rab dpe bsdur ma pod bzhi pa bzhugs/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gnas lnga rig pa'i dbang phyug slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo'i zhabs kyi gsung rab dpe bsdur ma pod bzhi pa bzhugs/ /

༄༅/ /dpal kye'i rdo rje'i rab tu gnas pa bzang po drug ces bya ba bzhugs so/ / ༄༅/ /dpal kye'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal kye'i rdo rje'i rab tu gnas pa byed na bzang po drug tu shes par bya ste/ rten bzang po dang slob dpon bzang | | gnas bzang po dang dus bzang dang*/ /yo byad cho ga bzang po'o/ /de la rten bzang po ni rten gyi bya ba ma lus par yongs su rdzogs pa ste/ rten gang yin yang bzo'i bya ba rdzogs nas rten gyi dngos gzhi la phyis bzo bos bzo bya mi dgos pa'o/ /mchod rten la sogs par gzungs bzhugs pa la sogs ni rnal 'byor dbang phyug nyid dang*/ slob dpon kun dga' snying po'i dgongs pa phyogs gcig tu byas pa rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dang mthun pa kho bos logs shig tu byas pa der blta bar bya'o/ /slob dpon bzang po ni rdo rje slob dpon du dbang thob pa dang*/ de kho na nyid bcu shes pa dang*/ sngon chad las kyi cho ga mthong ba dang | lha'i rnal 'byor la gnas shing bsnyen pa yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /gnas bzang po ni bkra shis shing nyams dga' ba'i sa phyogs yin la/ rgyas par dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ltar yin no/ /dus bzang po ni gza' dang skar ma bkra shis pa'i dus te/ zla ba drug dang gza' bzhi dang*/ rgyu skar bcu bzhi zhes bya ba la sogs pa bzang po yongs su bzung ba las bshad pa bzhin yin la/ spyir yar gyi ngo dang khyad par du snga dro'i dus su rab gnas kyi dngos gzhi rdzogs par bya'o | | yo byad bzang po ni dkyil 'khor dang sbyin sreg la ma ltos pa'i rab tu gnas pa ni cho ga yongs su rdzogs pa ma yin pas/ sbyin sreg gi yo byad dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi yo byad dang*/ rab gnas kyi khyad par gyi yo byad do/ /dang po gnyis ni sngar bstan zin to/ /rab gnas kyi khyad par gyi yo byad ni/ ba'i rnam lnga dang dri lnga la sogs pa khrus kyi yo byad dang*/

yungs dkar dang bdug pa la sogs pa shis pa'i yo byad dang*/ me tog dang spos la sogs pa thun mong gi mchod pa'i yo byad dang*/ glegs thag dang rdo rings la sogs pa khyad par gyi mchod pa'i mnga' dbul pa'i yo byad dang*/ yon bdag bkra shis par bya ba'i yo byad do/ /cho ga yongs su dag pa ni spyir slob dpon bsnyen pa yongs su rdzogs pas las su bya ba ni gsum ste/ sta gon dang*/ dngos gzhi dang*/ mjug go | de la yang spy-ir cho ga'i dbye ba rgyas pa dang*/ bsdus par rang gi blos phye la shes par bya ste/ de'ang dkyil 'khor dang sbyin sreg dang ma 'brel pa'i rab gnas ni yongs su rdzogs pa ma yin la/ gal te cho ga byed na'ang bsdus te bstan pa'i cho ga de nyid kyis ci rigs par sbyar te shes par bya'o/ /'dir dkyil 'khor dang sbyin sreg dang 'brel ba'i cho ga rgyas par brjod de/ dang por slob dpon la gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ bsnyen pa dang*/ sa chog dang*/ sta gon dang | dkyil 'khor bri ba dang*/ dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod yan chad kyi cho ga sngar dbang gi skabs su bstan pa ltar khyad par med par bya'o/ /'on kyang slob ma dbang bskur mi byed par rab gnas kho na byed na slob ma sta gon mi dgos so | | gzhan khyad par med do/ /de la dbang bskur ba dang rab gnas thun mong du byed cing zhag gsum du byed na/ sgrub mchod rdzogs pa dang rab gnas kyi sta gon bya ste/ phyi nyin rab gnas kyi dngos gzhi byed la/ de'i nub mo slob dpon dang slob ma 'jug cing dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /nub gnyis pa'i dbang du byas na sgrub mchod zin pa dang rab gnas kyi sta gon byas nas/ de nas slob dpon dang slob ma 'jug cing dbang bskur ba byas la de'i tho rangs rab gnas kyi dngos gzhi bya ste/ de rdzogs nas dkyil 'khor gshegs su gsol bar bya'o/ / yang na nub gnyis pa 'di cho ga bsdus pa yin pas rab gnas kyi sta gon ma byas kyang nyes pa med de/

sgrub mchod kyi rjes la 'jug cing dbang bskur ba byas nas tho rangs rab gnas kyi dngos gzhi byas la/ dkyil 'khor gshegs su gsol ba la sogs pa mjug gi cho ga rnams bya'o/ /de la rab gnas kyi sta gon byed na don bdun te/ khrus byas pas sbyang zhing shis pa'i cho ga dang*/ stong par sbyang ba dang*/ yan lag bzhis bskyed pa dang*/ mchod bstod bya ba dang*/ snyan gsan dbab pa dang*/ gshegs su gsol ba dang*/ rten dgab cing bsrung ba bya ba'o/ /de la dang po gtor ma cho ga gang yang rung ba zhig gis btang ste bar chad zhi bar byas la/ de la khrus bya ba ni 'di yin te/ rten bkrur rung ba rnams la dngos su bya/ mi rung ba rnams la me long la bya ste/ dang por ba'i rnam lngas byug cing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi sho dha ne swā hā/ zhes brjod cing dūr ba'i chun po'i p-ir ram phag zes mnyes la/ sngags de nyid bzla zhing chu gtsang mas bshal bar bya'o/ /de nas mar nag gam dri zhim pos byug cing*/ oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.aḥzhes brjod pa dang*/ lugs sku dri mas zhen na nyi ma la yang gdung bar bya'o | | mar khu bsal ba'i don du u dumbā ra dang*/ shi ri sha dang*/ a shwattha dang*/ parka ti dang*/ n+yā grau dha ste/ /shun lpags lnga legs par btags la sngags de nyid kyis byug shun lpags med na sran ma'i phye mas byug par bya'o/ /de'i dri ma bkru ba'i phyir sug pa'i chu dang*/ chu gtsang mas kyang sngags de nyid kyis bkru zhing | sngags de bzlas la sngar bstan pa'i dri lngas kyang byug par bya'o/ /de nas sngar sta gon gyi dus su lhag par gnas pa byas pa'i bum pa rnams kyis khrus gsol te/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar | | lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis khrus bya'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ spros pa la dga' na/ khyod ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chus/

/ser sna'i dri ma sbyong mdzad cing*/ /gtong ba dri yis legs bsgos pa/ khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ya ma shri ye hūm̐/ khyod ni tshul khrims rang bzhin chus/ khrims 'chal dri ma sbyong mdzad cing*/ /tshul khrims dri yis legs bsgos pa/ khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ khyod ni bzod pa'i rang bzhin chus/ khong khro'i dri ma sbyong mdzad cing*/ /bzod pa'i dri yis legs bsgos pa/ khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ khyod ni brtson 'grus rang bzhin chus/ / le lo'i dri ma sbyong mdzad cing*/ /brtson 'grus dri yis legs bsgos pa/ khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ khyod ni bsam gtan rang bzhin chus/ /rnam g.yengs dri ma sbyong mdzad cing | | ting 'dzin dri yis legs bsgos pa/ khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal 'dud | oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ khyod ni shes rab rang bzhin chus/ /shes 'chal dri ma sbyong mdzad cing*/ /shes rab dri yis legs bsgos pa/ khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ chu bo drug gis khrus mdzad cing*/ dri ma rnam drug sbyong mdzad pa/ /rgya chen yon tan drug dang ldan/ khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal 'dud | | oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ gang la nyes pa mi mnga' zhing*/ /yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa'i/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod don du/ /dad pas bdag ni khrus gsol lo/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shṛ ye hūm̐/ de bzhin du bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa du ma brjod cing khrus bya'o/ khrus kyi 'dag chal la sogs pa ma grub na dri zhim po 'ba' zhig gis khrus bya'o/

/de nas sbyang zhing shis pa'i cho ga ni/ /sngar slob ma dbang bskur ba'i don du slob ma shis pa'i skabs su bshad pa dang 'dra bar shes par bya'o | | de nas gnyis pa stong par sbyang ba ni/ /oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswabhā wa shuddho ྅ haṃ/ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis rab tu gnas pa bya ba'i rten thams cad mi dmigs par bya'o/ /de nas gsum pa yan lag bzhis bskyed pa la bzhi/ dam tshig pa bskyed pa/ ye shes pa dgug pa/ byin gyis brlab pa/ dbang bskur ba'o | | dang po dam tshig pa bskyed pa ni mngon par byang chub pa rnam pa lnga'am rdo rje cho ga yan lag gsum las bskyed de/ de yang mchod rten dang lha khang ni rnam snang du bskyed/ glegs bam ni 'od dpag tu med pa/ phyag mtshan rnams ni mi bskyod pa/ sku gzugs ngo shes pa rnams ni lha gang yin pa/ ngo mi shes pa rnams ni rdo rje 'chang chen por bskyed do/ /de nas gnyis pa ye shes pa spyan drang ba ni/ rdo rje bzung la dril bu dkrol zhing*/ ji ltar rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ / dga' ldan du na gnas nas kyang*/ /lha mo sgyu 'phrul lhums zhugs ltar/ /de bzhin 'dir ni gshegs su gsol/ /zhes brjod la/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drang bar bya'o | | spyan drangs la sngar bshad pa bzhin zhabs bkru ba dang*/ zhal bkru ba dang | bsang gtor dang*/ mchod yon byas la/ oṃ badzra padma ka ma lā ya st+waṃ/ / zhes bya bas me tog gi gdan phul la/ ci 'byor pa'i mchod pa dang bstod pa bya'o | | de nas sku gzugs dam tshig pa'i gnas gsum du yi ge 'bru gsum bkod la sngags bzlas te/ ye shes pa'i phyi nas 'brangs pa'i bgegs bsrungs la/ ye shes pa spyan drang ba'i phyir/ oṃ badzra gau rī ā karṣa ya dzaḥ zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i sngags dang lcags kyu la sogs pa'i phyag rgya dang*/ lha mo bzhi'i ting nge 'dzin gyis dgug

gzhug bcings/ dbang du bya ba'o/ /de nas gsum pa skye mched dang sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa'ang sgrub thabs bzhin bya'o/ /de nas bzhi pa dbang bskur te dbu rgyan gyi bar du yan lag bzhi yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /de nas spyi don bzhi pa mchod bstod ni/ phyi me tog la sogs pa'i mchod pa dang*/ sngag dang*/ phyag rgya dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi mchod pa rnam pa nyi shu la sogs pa dang*/ bdud rtsi'i mchod pa dang*/ lha mo brgyad kyi mchod pa dang*/ bstod pa'i mchod pa'i bar du ji ltar nus pas mchod par bya'o | | de nas lnga pa snyan gsan phab la/ cho ga lhag chad kha bskang zhing yi ge brgya pa brjod pas bzod par gsol te/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas 'di skad du/ he zhes bya ba'i bcom ldan 'das/ /rig sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / ces bya ba la sogs pa sngar sta gon gyi skabs su bshad pa dang 'dra ba las/ nangs par dkyil 'khor bri/ zhes bya ba'i skabs su/ nangs par rab gnas bgyid | ces bya ba gzhug ste gzhan ni 'dra/ de lan gsum rjod la slar yang 'di skad du/ bdag rdo rje slob dpon che ge mo zhes bya ba la/ slob ma che ge mo zhes bya bas gsol ba btab ste/ khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad kyi don gyi phyir sang nangs par rten che ge mo zhes bya ba la rab gnas bgyid pas bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po nyid kyi byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/zhes bya bas gsol ba gdab bo/ /de nas drug pa gshegs su gsol ba ni/ yi ge brgya pa'i mthar oṃ badzra muḥ zhes pas gshegs su gsol lo/ /bdun pa dgab pa ni dam tshig pa bdag la bsdus te/ da dung mchod pa la mi dbang ba mtshon pa'i phyir rten zhal bsgyur ba'am na bza' ser pos g.yogs la bzhag go/ de'ang rten la gnas gsum bsrung ba byas te bar chad mi 'jug par bya'o/ rab tu gnas pa'i sta gon gyi cho ga'o/ /de nas phyi de nyin par rab gnas kyi dngos gzhi'i cho ga ni/

'byor pa yod na mchod pa'i yo byad rgya cher gsar pa bsham/ rgya cher ma 'byor na'ang ji ltar 'byor pa bshams la bsang ba la sogs pa sngar bzhin byas pas chog gsung*/ gtor ma rgya cher bya'o/ /de nas dngos gzhi la'ang bdun te/ rang lha'i rnal 'byor gsal btab la gtor ma btang ste khrus byas la rten sbyang zhing shis par bya ba dang*/ stong par sbyang ba dang*/ yan lag bzhis bskyed pa dang*/ mchod pa'i cho ga dang*/ spyan dbye ba dang*/ snying po bzlas te brtan par bzhugs pa dang*/ mnga' dbul ba'o/ /de la dang po gtor ma btang ba dang khrus byas nas dam tshig pa bskyed pa'i bar ni sta gon dang 'dra bar byas la/ de nas ye shes pa spyan drangs pa'i skabs su/ 'di zhes bya ba'i bcom ldan 'das/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pas snyan gsan dbab ste/ nangs par rab gnas bgyid par 'tshal zhes pa'i skabs su/ da ni rab gnas bgyid par 'tshal zhes pa gzhug go /gzhan yang spyan drang pa'i tshigs bcad 'di'ang spraus pa la dga' na brjod de/ chos rnams kun gyi dbang phyug gtso/ btso ma gser gyi mdog 'dra zhing*/ /nyi ma las lhag gzi brjid che/ /dad pas spyan ni drang bar bgyi/ /zhi zhing thugs rje cher ldan pa/ /dul zhing bsam gtan sa la bzhugs/ /chos dang ye shes chags bral ba/ /kun tu mi zad nus par ldan/ / tshur spyaun tshur spyaun zhi bdag lha/ /thub pa'i skyes mchog thams cad mkhyen/ / shin tu legs byas gzugs brnyan ni/ /mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol | | 'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu/ /'khor ba srid du bzhugs nas kyang | | nad med tshe dang dbang phyug rnams/ /sbyin pa legs par mdzad du gsol || zhes pa dang*/ yang*/ dmigs med mkha' ltar dag pas khyab pa'i sku// chos sku nam mkha' lta bur dbyer med kyang*/ /thabs dang shes rab gzugs brnyan skur ston pa/ /bcom ldan 'khor bcas 'dir ni gshegs su gsol/ / ma lus sems can kun gyi don slad du/

/bdud sde dpung bcas ma lus 'joms mdzad cing*/ /dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i/ /bcom ldan 'khor bcas 'dir ni gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ e hye hi bha ga wa te/ bha ga bāṃ sa ma ya artsa ma na arghaṃ pā dyaṃ pra tī tstshe daṃ pū dzā na tsarya pra siddhi me/ zhes bya bas spyan drangs la/ mchod yon phul te ci 'byor gyis mchod do/ /de nas bsrung ba ni sku gzugs dam tshig pa'i gnas gsum du yi ge bkod la/ rtsa ba'i sngags la sogs pa khro bo'i sngags zlo zhing ye shes pa'i phyi nas 'brangs pa'i bgegs bsal bar bya'o/ /de nas dgug gzhug bya ba ni/ ji ltar sangs rgyas thams cad dag /dga' ldan du ni gnas gyur kyang*/ /lha mo sgyu 'phrul lhums zhugs ltar | | de bzhin 'dir ni gshegs su gsol/ /zhes bya ba dang*/ oṃ badzra gau rī ā karṣa ya dzaḥzhes bya ba la sogs pa sngags dang phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin gyis dgug gzhug brtan par bya'o/ /'dir ni rtag tu bzhugs nas kyang*/ /brtse bas rjes su gzung ba dang*/ /byang chub sems ni rab 'phel gyis/ /brtan par 'dir ni bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ badzra dha ra dha ra dha ra ya dhā ra ya/ mardha mardha badzra dhṛ ka a dhi tiṣṭha/ oṃ sha shwa ta pa ra ma/ sha shwa ta/ e hye hi dzi na dzi ka a dhi tiṣṭha

| oṃ badzra surya ta mo bhi dha ma na sa ma ya st+waṃ haṃ ratna dhṛ ka a dh-i tiṣṭha/ oṃ badzra dharmā sa ma ya st+waṃ ྄hu lu hu lu a ro li ka a dhi tiṣṭha/ oṃ phuḥphuḥphuḥhi hi hi pradzñā dhṛ ka a dhi tiṣṭha/ oṃ mo ha ra ti a dhi tiṣṭha/ oṃ dāe ṣa ra ti a nghi tiṣṭha/ oṃ rā ga ra ti a dhi tiṣṭha | oṃ badzra ra ti a dhi tiṣṭha/ zhes bya bas spyan drangs pa brtan par bzhugs su gsol | de nas skye mched dang sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa sgrub thabs bzhin bya/ dbang bskur zhing rigs kyi bdag po'i rgyas gdab pa'ang sgrub slob dpon rtse mo'i gsung rab dpe bsdur ma pod bzhi pa/ mes po'i shul bzhag las/ sa skya bka' 'bum/ PAGE 8PAGE 9 slob dpon rtse mo'i gsung rab dpe bsdur ma pod bzhi pa/ mes po'i shul bzhag las/ sa skya bka' 'bum/ PAGE 2PAGE 1
